provisionalDecisions.note: Owner decisions resolved provisionally with the recommended defaults. Changing a decision here is the whole edit: every row whose replacement names this decision takes its family and compatibility from it. A recorded measurement for a different family is ignored (treated as unmeasured) until scripts/measure-font-replacements.mjs is re-run.

aptos-preview.note: Owner policy 2026-09-29: a licensed font the user selects previews with an open replacement that looks similar and has the same size on screen; the PPTX keeps the selected name. cambria-tier.note: Cambria -> Caladea is visual: advances differ from Cambria 6.99 by a mean of 2.7%. metricModeFallback keeps metric-mode registries previewing Cambria with Caladea (reported as visual), as they did before FF-31.

description: OPF font policy (font-fidelity-everywhere FF-31). One row per font family that OPF catalogs, defaults or renderer rules name. Renderers preview a proprietary family with its openly licensed replacement for measurement and drawing only. Exporters always write the chosen family, never write a replacement, and never embed a proprietary family. Open families may be bundled for rendering and reach a PPTX only through an explicit embed path. See docs/font-fidelity.md.

measurement.tool: fontkit 2.0.4 shaping with default features (kerning, ligatures), as opf-render measures text; a replacement that lists disabledFeatures (Georgia -> Gelasio) is shaped with those features off
measurement.corpus: 300 Latin title/body strings sampled from the 126 bundled example decks
measurement.definition: For each style both fonts have (regular, bold, italic, bold italic, or the weight the family name encodes), the shaped advance width of every corpus string in the replacement is divided by the width in the real font. meanAbsWidthDelta averages |ratio - 1| over strings and styles; meanWidthDelta averages the signed value; maxAbsWidthDelta is the largest single-string |ratio - 1|. Reference fonts were read in place from a licensed Windows 11 + Microsoft 365 host and never copied.

replacement.lineAscentBasis: opf#361 native probe (PowerPoint 365 16.0 build 20430, 2026-10-10; RR-38 setup: one-line text boxes, wrap none, zero insets, top anchor, 100 percent line spacing, black on white, slides exported at 2880 px): the baseline is the bottom edge of the last pixel row that holds at least 35 percent of the darkest row's ink (for a headline script, the most common bottom of the letter stems), in em below the line-box top; PowerPoint puts the line top at the box top and makes the line 1.20 em high for every family. Evidence: docs/evidence/ff-46-sizeadjust-native-20261010. Angsana New 5.06 (attempt 3): 0.833 / 0.833 / 0.833 em at 18 / 24 / 32 pt regular (bold 0.836); a line with an Aptos Latin run 0.856 / 0.866 / 0.862. Replaces the 2026-10-05 FF-46 reading of 0.85 (1280 px PNGs, one pixel = 0.04 em at 18.75 pt).
replacement.sizeAdjustBasis: opf#361 rule (release supervisor, 2026-10-10): the smallest single factor (0.01 steps, rounded up) at which no line of the line model overhangs by more than 3 percent natively, over the FF-44 corpus samples of the script that the real font covers (letters, digits, punctuation, mixed) plus the Latin of a scheme set to this family (the corpus Latin group and the 300 FF-31 strings), regular and bold. Line model: opf-render 0.18.0 plans each line for a deck whose font scheme is the family; the factor scales every run drawn in this replacement, Latin included; native width = the real font's fontkit advance, read in place from C:\Windows\Fonts. Evidence: docs/evidence/ff-46-sizeadjust-native-20261010. Angsana New 5.06 over Noto Sans Thai: the sum of the real font's advances over the replacement's is 0.703 regular and 0.668 bold (7 Thai samples); the rule factor is 0.7401, set by thai-digits (regular), and rounds up to 0.75, where the worst line overhangs 1.6 percent. The Latin of an Angsana New scheme keeps 23.8 percent slack (median; native / preview 0.72 to 0.84), never overhang. Native re-run with the factor (FF-46 decks, attempt 2): native / preview ink 0.949 on long lines, no native-only overflow.

Gelasio is designed to Georgia metrics and every basic-Latin advance matches Georgia 5.59. With default features Gelasio applies fi/fl/ffi/ffl ligatures that Georgia does not, which changes runs by up to 1.02%. Renderers therefore turn liga and clig off in Gelasio (disabledFeatures); the measurement below shapes Gelasio that way. Georgia has no liga or clig feature, so its default shaping is unchanged. The metric claim holds only with those features off.

replacement.sizeAdjustBasis: opf#361 rule (release supervisor, 2026-10-10): the smallest single factor (0.01 steps, rounded up) at which no line of the line model overhangs by more than 3 percent natively, over the FF-44 corpus samples of the script that the real font covers (letters, digits, punctuation, mixed) plus the Latin of a scheme set to this family (the corpus Latin group and the 300 FF-31 strings), regular and bold. Line model: opf-render 0.18.0 plans each line for a deck whose font scheme is the family; the factor scales every run drawn in this replacement, Latin included; native width = the real font's fontkit advance, read in place from C:\Windows\Fonts. Evidence: docs/evidence/ff-46-sizeadjust-native-20261010. Malgun Gothic 6.69 over Noto Sans KR: the sum of the real font's advances over the replacement's is 1.063 regular and 1.061 bold (4 Korean samples); with precomposed Hangul (the text real documents use) the rule factor is 1.0557 (kore-sentence, regular); the decomposed conjoining-jamo sample kore-jamo (U+1100-11FF, U+A960-A97F, U+D7B0-D7FF) needs 1.0669 and is excluded from the row decision as a documented limitation (PowerPoint draws decomposed jamo unshaped, up to 1.9 times wider; no factor fixes it). Supervisor decision: 1.07, where the worst precomposed line overhangs 1.6 percent. The Latin of a Malgun Gothic scheme keeps 8.0 percent slack (median; 0.87 to 0.96). Native re-run with the factor (attempt 2): ink 1.021 on long lines without jamo; the one native-only overflow (82 pt) is the jamo line. No lineAscent: the native baseline sits 1.06 em below the line top (probe 1.056 / 1.056 / 1.042), below core's 1.0, which a renderer that only moves runs up cannot apply.

Sakkal Majalla 7.00 over Noto Naskh Arabic: the sum of the real font's advances over the replacement's is 0.803 regular and 0.796 bold (12 Arabic-script samples, letters 0.73 to 0.83); the rule factor is 0.8866, set by arab-fa-digits (regular; Arabic-Indic and Persian digits are 0.91 of the replacement), and rounds up to 0.89, where the worst line overhangs 2.6 percent. The Latin of a Sakkal Majalla scheme keeps 27.1 percent slack (median; native / preview 0.70 to 0.80). Native re-run with the factor (ar, ur and fa decks, attempt 2): ink 0.90 to 0.91, no native-only overflow.

Visual: every emoji sequence advances 1.2451 em in Noto Color Emoji against 1.3730 em in Segoe UI Emoji 1.33 (-9.3%); Noto Color Emoji has no Latin glyphs, so Latin text and digits of a Segoe UI Emoji run take a text face by glyph fallback. Symbol-encoded (FF-45): no text replacement; a renderer maps each code 0x20..0xFF through spec/reference/symbol-font-encodings.json (Adobe and Apple Symbol tables, verified against Windows Symbol 5.01: 189 of 224 codes have a Unicode equivalent) and previews the equivalent with the first loaded open face of Noto Sans (Greek letters, digits, punctuation), Noto Sans Math (operators, bracket pieces), Noto Sans Symbols 2 and Noto Sans Symbols, at the verified font's advance; the PPTX keeps the family and codes. macOS lists a "Symbol" (version 13.0d2e2), which is Apple's own build: 0x27, 0x6D, 0xE1, 0xF1 and 0xF0 (Apple logo) differ and are recorded per code.
